data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=7qCLUok8G1gQ7kNvgGYVWRa&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYATJN1vDEiHO-6C0qcq5VOcuzhwrFg4XeVZHrjzLEei7w&oe=671E249C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=qnKK-4Jq4rYQ7kNvgFMRN1B&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCZsWH1eDNZyuyKXrhGDKK2D5EeYPc1dvoe2Ef9jzXB9Q&oe=671E2E24)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=dO0C1mOTvkEQ7kNvgHyEGr2&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDrjCP_NyQYJxdhTfiK6Exrozj-KX4ZUsN2F6m6yswBEQ&oe=671E1587)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-4.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=xH5K-cakXroQ7kNvgFTPmqp&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-4.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCvGy9BwD_sm-RZgnmhqpqfQDtZuAr-90qP2z5Eaq3OMg&oe=671E0866)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=VxNsgpCBn2UQ7kNvgFqbb6g&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCvdhvg85pmaFrbJ8G0EL8LwDykUpOfPZWm29kb8tG8Mw&oe=671E34D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Ef3kfL8a-zIQ7kNvgFLtIez&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAApIggtIe6Rr6uVJpf7ywT1u1Z_BAQsdOWhIB9t_-5bA&oe=671E3159)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=IzQXeDCjf0gQ7kNvgGjdqvL&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAv2wuAN6pIOU_2wNnUuMM1XYeGMVITkwr77txq1G7n_A&oe=671E1770)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=JucPrYtS-YsQ7kNvgEIw7rR&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCfHJ8TKNZ6kwp4HX7y4d46e7IT4hsZhUfoXMv1uDBGZw&oe=671E3A2A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=7PKnsmNWWJQQ7kNvgHEZJYY&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin6-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBN7Bl9Bgteg_Rufa6U9_6TzTlAqRO2oQLYFcsI5E5LOg&oe=671E1597)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=mXb96rBWLb8Q7kNvgHk1jpJ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sin11-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAQrJ7tiCZJeN6DsmdbH9IuQHt84m_K_DYPRmsbESFgpQ&oe=671E310C)
